claims.assertion: Yazhi says frequency pods raise a person’s vibration so they no longer match astral entities, but lasting removal requires inner work and sustained changes in thought and habits.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: Otherwise, she says, entities may return.

claims.assertion: Yazhi says a person's frequency influences which extraterrestrial species or star people they may contact.
claims.speaker: Yazhi

claims.assertion: Yazhi rejects a literal solid dome over Earth, describing the Van Allen belts as the closest physical analogue.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: She says the Moon alters the magnetosphere to enhance them.
